Definition: properly, increasing; as noun, greatness, or (adverbially) greatly
BiblicalUsage: marbeh is increase, greatness, the growing of a thing. In Isaiah 9:7 it stands in the promise of the increase of His government and peace, with no end, upon the throne of David, and in Isaiah 33:23 it names the prey of a great spoil divided when the enemy's tackle fails. The word is growth and abundance together.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe marbeh shows me that God increases what is His, and I hold that the increase of His government is the only increase that never ends.
RelatedTopics: Kingdom of God; God's Provision; Peace
